item.title: Peoria police seek missing man last seen in 2025
item.description: Peoria police are searching for Jason C. Mizell, a 48-year-old white male with brown hair and green eyes, who was last seen in early 2025 and is possibly homeless.

item.title: Nonprofit donates body armor for Mackinaw police dog
item.description: Mackinaw police dog K9 Tsunami will receive a bullet and stab protective vest from Vested Interest in K9s, Inc. thanks to a donation from Karla Kimmey of Port Charlotte, Fla.

item.title: Tazewell County dispatch outage, call 911 for urgent services
item.description: Tazewell County dispatch non-emergency lines are down and people needing police, fire or EMS services are asked to call 9-9-1 until the connection is restored.

item.title: Man convicted in bench trial for severely injuring 5-year-old boy
item.description: Carl Rogers Jr. was found guilty of aggravated battery and faces up to 30 years in prison for causing severe head injuries to a 5-year-old boy in his care.

item.title: Two-vehicle crash temporarily closes part of Knoxville Avenue
item.description: A two-vehicle crash temporarily closed part of North Knoxville Avenue near West Detweiller Drive on Wednesday, resulting in minor injuries to one person.

item.title: Peoria emergency officials gain hands on power line safety training
item.description: Ameren Electric sponsored a live power line training session for first responders in Peoria, Illinois to provide them with expert instructions on how to handle, identify, and assess potential hazards when dealing with live wires in emergency situations.

item.title: East Bluff Community Center comes under new ownership
item.description: The Catholic Diocese of Peoria has sold the East Bluff Community Center property to Centerpoint Community Church, which will continue to operate the food pantry and St. Bernard Church.

item.title: Remembering Challenger: 40 years after the tragic explosion
item.description: The Challenger Center was created by the families of the lost crew members of the Challenger Space Shuttle to honor their legacy and continue to inspire future generations to be curious and courageous.

item.title: Ropp Jersey Cheese to close after 20 years in business
item.description: The six-generation Ropp family farm is closing its Ropp Jersey Cheese business on February 7, 2026, after 20 years of offering over 30 kinds of cheese profiles to customers in a 100-mile radius of Bloomington-Normal.

item.title: UPDATE: Peoria County Coroner identifies man killed in early morning shooting
item.description: One man was killed and a woman was injured in an early morning shooting in Peoria County, and the suspects left the area before deputies arrived.
